assets.usage: lantern-table cloth albedo and UI backdrop, not a normal/roughness map or seamless tile
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production game texture, flat albedo for a small tabletop cloth and the background of a cozy card-table interface in a 3D seafaring home-building game.
Primary request: an original, beautifully crafted dark sea-teal woven linen cloth with a thin restrained antique-gold stitched border and tiny embroidered wave-and-lantern motifs only near the corners. Warm, tactile, lived-in, elegant rather than casino-like. Fine visible weave, a few natural irregularities in the thread. The large central 80 percent is plain quiet teal so actual game cards and readable text can be rendered on top by code.
Composition/framing: perfectly straight overhead orthographic view of the fabric surface, edge-to-edge square flat material swatch, no perspective, no folds that distort the plane. Border fully inside the image with comfortable padding.
Lighting: diffuse neutral flat illumination suitable for albedo; no cast shadows, no baked spotlight, no specular highlights.
Constraints: fabric only; no cards, objects, hands, people, furniture, letters, numbers, text, logos, watermarks, or branded patterns. No fake screenshot or UI. Not a concept render of a room. Subtle sophisticated craft detail, no excessive ornaments.
